notes:
New
- Bring your library reads Apple Photos: Allow access, a plan by year and month, and an import that downloads originals kept only in iCloud, videos included
- Bring your library’s plan is a folder tree with Working, Archive or Skip per folder, totals, and a re-check of missing originals
- Meki Cloud has three modes in the Cloud button: Offline, Data Saver and Online
- A watched export folder brings exports back from any editor; the main editor can be Other, Capture One or None, and Lightroom Classic has a setup status and a round-trip test
- Compare up to 100 photos, a Reference view with pinned photos, and Before / After with four layouts and a draggable split
- Culling gives each photo an exposure verdict, with a tile chip, an Info row and an Exposure filter
- Contact sheets in Prints, with captions and PDF output; New export offers multi-photo templates
- The Shared tab and an All shares page, and a gallery Preview that shows the gallery as visitors see it
- Settings › Customise sets the sidebar’s pages, sections, filter bar pins and Info panel, and follows the library to your other Macs
- A Clients page, Home as Continue and your projects by status, and Tasks grouped by due date, project or project status
- Settings › Storage in three tabs: one job per drive, network drives by address, and a scan that finds photos already on a drive
- Setup has new Catalog, Drives and Workflow steps, and Settings › Features switches turn whole features on or off

Improved
- Before an original leaves this Mac, Meki asks Meki Cloud afresh and re-reads the whole file; a damaged Meki Cloud copy is replaced from the original still here
- Copies are counted more strictly: two volumes on one disk are one copy, drive copies are checked when the drive connects, and a removed Mac’s copies no longer count
- Automatic permanent deletes above 500 photos wait for you, with Ignore
- Turning a gallery’s link off asks first, and turning it on again makes a new link; Stop sharing is gone
- Gallery hearts show to you as counts only
- Settings pages, dialogs, popovers, the Info panel, Maps, People, Inbox, Outputs and the post editor follow the updated design, and Settings opens on Account
- The title-bar search filters the current photo page, and the filter bar is pinned on grids with Sort and the photo count
- Archived photos get grid previews for Meki Cloud in the background, read from a connected drive first
- Every plugin carries a 256 px PNG icon, shown in Settings › Plugins
- Phocus support is removed: Hasselblad raws open in the chosen editor and edits return through the watched export folder
- Automations stay off after updating until you turn them on

Fixed
- Bring your library never deletes a file on the wrong drive when the same files go to the working drive and an archive
- With the same library on two Macs, a project moved to Meki Cloud on one is followed by the other, and removing the old drive, Back up only and Remove Meki Cloud keep what only Meki Cloud holds
- Import again in Bring your library retries the same import instead of starting a second one, and a plan that can’t be read says so with Try again
- Offload now finishes when a photo is in no project, and a run that fails says why and waits for Retry
- A size-only Meki Cloud confirmation never lets an original go, and a failed monthly check stops counting that cloud copy
- A trashed photo’s original is freed only when its copies elsewhere were checked just then
- Setup turns Meki Cloud on as backup only and never changes a drive’s job
- An old copy of a catalog no longer overrides newer changes on Meki Cloud
- A print export run again after a crash finishes instead of “This print job is gone”
- Dates in Settings follow Settings › Region
- A raw and its JPEG count once in a drive scan
- Smaller fixes across the loupe, project tabs, tasks, People, Instagram, Create and Settings
